questions.question_text: What is a monolith architecture?

options.option_text: An architecture with many small services
A single-tiered software application where components are interconnected

questions.question_text: What are the characteristics of a monolithic application?

options.option_text: Single codebase, single deployment unit, shared resources
Each component has its own database

questions.question_text: What is a typical example of a monolithic application?

options.option_text: A traditional e-commerce application with all modules in one codebase

questions.question_text: How do components communicate in a monolith?

questions.question_text: What is a single codebase in monolith architecture?

questions.question_text: What is the deployment process for a monolithic application?

options.option_text: Deploy the entire application as a single unit

questions.question_text: What is microservices architecture?

options.option_text: An architectural style that structures an app as a collection of small services

questions.question_text: What is a service in microservices architecture?

questions.question_text: How do microservices communicate with each other?

questions.question_text: What is the difference between monolith and microservices?
